تستأنسون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنِسُونَ (tastaʔnisūna) /tas.taʔ.ni.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# تُسْتَأْنَسُونَ (tustaʔnasūna) /tus.taʔ.na.suː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
